title: For each RBAC action, show the action (with repeated action labels suppress
question: For each RBAC action, show the action (with repeated action labels suppressed and including a grand TOTAL row), the average/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version considering only IPv4 subnets on networks referenced by RBAC entries, the total number of distinct subnets involved, and—when the action is specifically 'access_as_shared'—also show the variance of subnet IP version across IPv4 vs IPv6 plus the average of that variance across all 'access_as_shared' RBAC actions. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT r.action, s.id AS subnet_id, s.ip_version
  FROM networkrbacs r
  JOIN networks n ON n.id = r.object_id
  JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id
  WHERE s.ip_version = 4
),
agg AS (
  SELECT action,
         AVG(ip_version) AS avg_v,
         VARIANCE(ip_version) AS var_v,
         STDDEV(ip_version) AS std_v,
         COUNT(DISTINCT subnet_id) AS distinct_subnets
  FROM base
  GROUP BY action
),
grand AS (
  SELECT 'TOTAL' AS action,
         AVG(ip_version) AS avg_v,
         VARIANCE(ip_version) AS var_v,
         STDDEV(ip_version) AS std_v,
         COUNT(DISTINCT subnet_id) AS distinct_subnets
  FROM base
),
shared AS (
  SELECT r.action,
         VARIANCE(s.ip_version) AS var_v4v6
  FROM networkrbacs r
  JOIN networks n ON n.id = r.object_id
  JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id
  WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared'
  GROUP BY r.action
),
shared_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(var_v4v6) AS avg_var_v4v6
  FROM shared
)
SELECT a.action,
       a.avg_v,
       a.var_v,
       a.std_v,
       a.distinct_subnets,
       sh.var_v4v6,
       sa.avg_var_v4v6
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN shared sh ON sh.action = a.action
CROSS JOIN shared_avg sa
UNION ALL
SELECT g.action, g.avg_v, g.var_v, g.std_v, g.distinct_subnets, NULL, NULL
FROM grand g

  FROM networkrbacs nr

  FROM combined GROUP BY action WITH ROLLUP
)
